subject: Renewal + route add: NeuralForge expansion & $/1M alignment
messages:
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@neuralforge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: NeuralForge Procurement <procurement@neuralforge.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: NeuralForge renewal: early signal + route-add question

Hi Olga / Ben —

Quick follow-up from our call today. High level: NeuralForge intends to renew for another 12 months and wants to expand usage across two new routes (OCR preprocessing + multimodal embeddings). Procurement asked me to surface target economics early so they can draft a budget. A few datapoints from our side: 

- Current average: ~2.1M tokens / month (generation-heavy)
- Target post-expansion (Q1 ramp): 4.5–6.0M tokens / month across combined routes
- Procurement target budget: aiming for ~$800–$1,200 per 1M tokens for blended spend (they emphasized predictability more than aggressive deep discounts)

Specific asks:
1) Can Redwood outline a blended-rate approach across routes (generation vs embeddings/ocr) and what step-up bands look like?
2) What unit economics / $/1M range do you expect at 3M / 5M / 10M monthly volumes?
3) Any restrictions or minimums for adding new routes/models to a renewal?

I've attached a simple volume banding worksheet Procurement asked us to fill out — they'll want a proposed pricing matrix to attach to the renewal SOW. Can we aim to get a first-pass pricing matrix + short rationale by Friday?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

—Emma
Emma Johnson
Head of AI Products, NeuralForge
emma.johnson@neuralforge.com
[Attachment: NeuralForge_Q4_volume_bands.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@neuralforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T18:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NeuralForge renewal: early signal + route-add question

Emma — thanks for the clear notes and the worksheet. Looping in Ben and Aditya to own pricing math and Priyom on route-add gating (security/ops).

Quick clarifying questions before we model:
- For the OCR route, is tokenization measured post-preprocessing (i.e., the same token definition you used previously) or do you expect larger prefix tokens because of image-to-text noise?
- For multimodal embeddings, what % of the new traffic do you expect to be low-latency (sub-300ms SLO) vs batch? That affects whether we recommend a dedicated route or blended hosted route.
- Do you have preferred billing cadence (monthly invoice vs quarterly true-up)? Procurement mentioned they prefer monthly for cash-flow.

Next steps proposed:
1) Ben/Aditya to send a first-pass blended-rate matrix with $/1M targets for 3/5/10M by 2026-11-20 EOD.
2) Priyom to confirm any ops/config constraints for adding OCR & embeddings as routes and list any minimal ramp windows.
3) Schedule a 30-min pricing alignment w/ Procurement — Emma, do you have availability on Monday (11/22) or Tuesday (11/23)?

I'll attach a draft amendment template and a route-add checklist to speed the contracting side.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-draft-amendment-v2.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@neuralforge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NeuralForge renewal: early signal + route-add question (pricing matrix)

Emma / team — attaching the first-pass pricing model (see Drive link in email footer). Highlighted assumptions:

Assumptions:
- Token definition aligned with previous contract (we used standard GPT-style tokenization) — if OCR noise increases token counts, we'll review with a short sample set.
- Blended rates consider 70% generation / 30% embeddings/ocr for forecast; we'll recalculate if NeuralForge expects a different split.
- Minimum committed band for step-up pricing: 3M tokens/mo for next 12 months to qualify for step discounts.

Proposed blended $/1M (indicative, before legal/contract):
- 1–2.9M: $1,500 / 1M tokens
- 3–4.9M: $1,100 / 1M tokens
- 5–9.9M: $900 / 1M tokens
- 10M+: $750 / 1M tokens

Illustrative scenarios (monthly total tokens):
- 3M: blended ~$1,100 / 1M (annualized commitment, standard support)
- 5M: blended ~$950 / 1M (we can reach $900 with 12+ month commit and small volume ramp)
- 6M: blended ~$900 / 1M with a 12-month step-up and inclusion of embeddings route as part of the blended base

Notes on adding routes/models:
- Adding OCR as a route: operationally straightforward; recommended 2–4 week ramp in Dedicated or hybrid mode for latency-sensitive workloads.
- Multimodal embeddings: if you want to guarantee <300ms p95, we'd recommend a small dedicated pool which increases the effective blended rate slightly; if batch is OK, hosted pooling keeps unit cost lower.

Next steps (I can own the matrix update):
- Olga to confirm routing split (est % generation vs embeddings/ocr).
- Emma to confirm Procurement's preferred cadence + whether they want the blended matrix locked into an amendment vs SOW line items.
- I will prepare an amended pricing sheet and a short rationale doc for Procurement.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: route-add-checklist.csv]

From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@neuralforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: NeuralForge Procurement <procurement@neuralforge.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NeuralForge renewal: early signal + route-add question (pricing matrix)

Thanks Ben — this is exactly the shape Procurement needed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- The expected split for Q1 ramp is closer to 60% generation / 25% embeddings / 15% OCR. We can re-run with that weight.
- Procurement confirms monthly billing + a 30-day true-up. They asked if Redwood will consider a mid-band anchor: if NeuralForge commits to 5M/mo guaranteed, can we lock $900 / 1M as a blended anchor for 12 months?

Request: please send the updated matrix with the 60/25/15 split and an explicit line for a 5M guaranteed anchor at $900 / 1M if possible. Also include expected latency implications for the 15% OCR load if we keep hosted pooling vs a small dedicated pool.

We can meet Monday 11/22 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute sync — send a calendar invite and the updated pricing sheet before the call.

I will also upload the completed volume bands worksheet to the Drive link you provided.

—Emma
Emma Johnson
Head of AI Products, NeuralForge
[Attachment: NeuralForge_Q4_volume_bands.xlsx (updated)]
